runbook_name: SHS Operator Runbook V1 - Phase 1: Lead Intake
goal: Document and audit the exact process for taking a new SHS lead from first interest to qualified opportunity.
entry_condition: A person or organization has expressed interest in SHS, requested a demo, been referred by a partner, appeared as a growth/opportunity signal, or otherwise created enough context for an operator to review fit.
exit_condition: Ready for Sales Handoff: the lead has minimum contact, organization, problem, budget/timeline, package recommendation, qualification decision, owner, next action, and stage recorded for sales follow-up.

required_route_page_if_exists.notes: Tracks sales pipeline items, stages, estimated value, priority, due dates, next action, notes, review events, and links to Opportunities and Bundle Builder.
Tracks opportunity signals, buyer, source, value, urgency, stage, partner/package context, and next actions.
Collects public demo/contact fields, but no runtime submit/persistence handler was found in this audit.

missing_or_incomplete_route_page.notes: The Sales app Leads route renders only a stub and is not sufficient as the V1 operator lead intake surface.
No dedicated SHS Lead Intake admin route/page was found.

sidebar_status.finding: AdminSidebar exposes Production Ops, Operations, Analytics, and System sections, but no direct Sales Pipeline or Lead Intake link was found.

required_data_fields.description: Where the lead came from: demo request, referral, event, partner, existing client, growth signal, manual.
Work email used for follow-up and demo scheduling.
Phone number if provided or needed for high-intent follow-up.
Organization, company, agency, or client name.
Nonprofit, government, funder, workforce/education, program operator, business, or other.
Operational sector or market: healthcare, home care, legal, nonprofit, workforce, logistics, education, professional services, etc.
The operational, reporting, website, client delivery, or system problem they need solved.
Estimated available budget or buying capacity. If unknown, mark unknown and ask during discovery.
Desired start or demo timeframe: urgent, within 2 weeks, 2-4 weeks, 1-2 months, just exploring.
Initial recommended SHS package or service path.
New, needs discovery, qualified opportunity, nurture, disqualified.
SHS operator or sales owner responsible for next action.
Concrete next step before sales handoff.

operator_checklist: Capture contact information: first name, last name, work email, and phone if available.
Capture organization/client details: organization name, organization type, role, geography if relevant.
Summarize the problem they need solved in one plain-language sentence.
Capture budget range or mark unknown and schedule discovery to resolve it.
Capture timeline or preferred demo timeframe.
Recommend an initial package based on problem, industry, urgency, and budget.
Move to Ready for Sales Handoff only when required fields and qualification decision are complete.

package_recommendation_rules.condition: Needs public website, template, brand, or simple service page
Needs operational dashboard, workflow, roles, internal process, or team visibility
Needs client portal, onboarding, support, knowledge base, or client delivery layer
Needs scheduling, routing, dispatch, logistics, or field coordination
Needs reporting, verified outcomes, proof, audit trail, or funder/leadership visibility
Needs multi-system build with workflow, website, reporting, and ClientOps

qualification_checklist.pass_condition: The lead can name the operational or public-facing problem SHS would solve.
Organization/client identity and contact are known.
The contact is a decision-maker, influencer, or can introduce one.
Budget range is known or discovery is scheduled to resolve it.
Timeline is known and not incompatible with SHS capacity.
At least one SHS package maps to the problem.
No obvious privacy, security, legal, or public-claim blocker prevents discovery.
A concrete next action and owner are assigned.

definition_of_done: Contact and organization details are recorded.
Industry and problem statement are recorded.
Budget range and timeline are recorded or explicitly marked unknown with discovery action.
Owner and next action are assigned.
Lead status is Qualified Opportunity or Nurture/Disqualified with reason.
If qualified, the lead is ready to appear in Sales Pipeline or Production Handoff review.
findings: SHS has a usable Hub Sales Pipeline route for sales review: admin.html#/hub/sales-pipeline.
SHS has a usable Hub Opportunities route for opportunity context: admin.html#/hub/opportunities.
The public Request Demo page collects many lead fields, including contact, organization, role, problem, source, and timeframe.
No dedicated Lead Intake admin page was found.
The Sales app /sales.html#/leads page exists but is a stub.
Budget range is not clearly collected in the public Request Demo form.
Package recommendation and qualification status are operator-derived today, not a dedicated intake workflow.
launch_blockers: No dedicated lead intake route/page for first-interest to qualified opportunity.
Public Request Demo form appears presentational; no submit/persistence handler was found.
Sales Leads route is a stub.
Budget range and package recommendation are not captured in the public lead form.
AdminSidebar does not expose a direct Sales Pipeline or Lead Intake link.
No single lead qualification record schema was found for the operator to complete before Sales Handoff.
post_v1_improvements: Create a dedicated Lead Intake page or make /sales.html#/leads fully functional.
Persist Request Demo submissions into a review queue.
Add budget range, package interest, and urgency fields to lead intake.
Add qualification status and owner assignment workflow.
Add direct AdminSidebar navigation to Sales Pipeline or Lead Intake.
Connect Qualified Opportunity to Sales Handoff without duplicate manual entry.
Add basic duplicate lead detection by email/domain/organization.
